intro: The Foreman's Blackjack is a heavy leather-wrapped cosh loaned out to fresh Horde recruits in the Valley of Trials. Taskmasters hand it down as an everyday disciplinary tool to wake slumbering peons and enforce the grueling pace of Durotar's early construction.

p: Building a new home in the rugged desert of Durotar requires massive stockpiles of lumber, and the labor falls squarely on the shoulders of the Horde's peons. In the Valley of Trials, Foreman Thazz'ril relies on the Foreman's Blackjack to keep work crews moving. Rather than dealing lethal blows, this weighted bludgeon is designed to deliver a jarring wake-up call to laborers caught napping beneath the valley's shade trees. It serves as a stark reminder of peon life in the new Horde: grueling, unglamorous, and supervised with an iron fist.
